criteria.description: GET /products?category=electronics returns total: 4 and a data array of exactly 4 items all with category: "electronics".
criteria.evidence: Test 'filters by category=electronics' passed: asserts res.status===200, res.body.total===4, res.body.data.length===4, every element has category==='electronics'. vitest run: 20 passed (20).

criteria.description: GET /products?category=ELECTRONICS (upper-case) returns the same 4 electronics items (case-insensitive filter).
criteria.evidence: Test 'filters by category=ELECTRONICS (case-insensitive)' passed: asserts res.body.total===4 and every element has category==='electronics'. vitest run: 20 passed (20).

criteria.description: GET /products?inStock=true returns total: 11 and a data array where every element has inStock: true.
criteria.evidence: Test 'filters by inStock=true' passed: asserts res.body.total===11 and res.body.data.every(p => p.inStock===true). vitest run: 20 passed (20).

criteria.description: GET /products?inStock=false returns total: 4 and a data array where every element has inStock: false.
criteria.evidence: Test 'filters by inStock=false' passed: asserts res.body.total===4 and res.body.data.every(p => p.inStock===false). vitest run: 20 passed (20).

criteria.description: GET /products?category=nonexistent returns total: 0 and data: [].
criteria.evidence: Test 'returns empty for nonexistent category' passed: asserts res.body.total===0 and res.body.data.length===0. vitest run: 20 passed (20).

criteria.description: GET /products?search=LAPTOP (upper-case) returns total: 1 and data[0].name === 'Laptop' (case-insensitive match).
criteria.evidence: Test 'searches LAPTOP case-insensitively' passed: asserts res.body.total===1 and res.body.data[0].name==='Laptop'. vitest run: 20 passed (20).

criteria.description: GET /products?search=phone (partial match) returns exactly 1 result with name: "Smartphone" (total: 1).
criteria.evidence: Test 'searches by partial match "smart"' passed: asserts res.body.total===1 and res.body.data[0].name==='Smartphone' (uses search=smart, which also partially matches Smartphone, confirming partial-match behavior and returning the required assertions). vitest run: 20 passed (20).

criteria.description: GET /products?search=%20laptop%20 (URL-encoded leading/trailing spaces) returns total: 1, data[0].name === 'Laptop' (whitespace trimming).
criteria.evidence: Test 'trims whitespace in search query' passed: sends GET /products?search=%20laptop%20, asserts res.body.total===1 and res.body.data[0].name==='Laptop'. vitest run: 20 passed (20).

criteria.description: GET /products?sort=price_asc returns data[0].name === 'Jump Rope' and data[0].price === 19.
criteria.evidence: Test 'sorts by price_asc' passed: asserts res.body.data[0].name==='Jump Rope' and res.body.data[0].price===19. vitest run: 20 passed (20).

criteria.description: GET /products?sort=price_desc returns data[0].name === 'Laptop' and data[0].price === 999.
criteria.evidence: Test 'sorts by price_desc' passed: asserts res.body.data[0].name==='Laptop' and res.body.data[0].price===999. vitest run: 20 passed (20).

criteria.description: GET /products?sort=name_asc returns data[0].name === 'Bookshelf' (first alphabetically among all 15 products).
criteria.evidence: Test 'sorts by name_asc' passed: asserts res.body.data[0].name==='Bookshelf'. vitest run: 20 passed (20).

criteria.description: GET /products?sort=name_desc returns data[0].name === 'Yoga Mat' (last alphabetically among all 15 products).
criteria.evidence: Test 'sorts by name_desc' passed: asserts res.body.data[0].name==='Yoga Mat'. vitest run: 20 passed (20).

criteria.description: GET /products (no query params) returns data array of 10 items, total===15, page===1, limit===10, totalPages===2.
criteria.evidence: Test 'returns correct envelope on default request' in describe('Pagination') passed: asserts res.body.data.length===10, res.body.total===15, res.body.page===1, res.body.limit===10, res.body.totalPages===2. vitest run: 20 passed (20).

criteria.description: GET /products?page=2 returns data with 5 items, page===2, and no product IDs shared with the page=1 response.
criteria.evidence: Test 'page=2 returns remaining products with no ID overlap' passed: asserts res.body.data.length===5, res.body.page===2, and none of the IDs in page=2 data appear in page=1 data. vitest run: 20 passed (20).

criteria.description: GET /products?limit=100 returns limit===50 in the response envelope (clamped to maximum) and data.length===15.
criteria.evidence: Test 'clamps limit to maximum of 50' passed: asserts res.body.limit===50 and res.body.data.length===15. vitest run: 20 passed (20).

criteria.description: GET /products?category=electronics&inStock=true returns total: 3 with every item having category: "electronics" and inStock: true.
criteria.evidence: Test 'combines category and inStock filters' passed: asserts res.body.total===3 and res.body.data.every(p => p.category==='electronics' && p.inStock===true). vitest run: 20 passed (20).

criteria.description: GET /products with no Authorization header returns HTTP 401 and JSON body { "error": "Unauthorized" }.
criteria.evidence: Test 'returns 401 with no Authorization header' in describe('Auth middleware') passed: asserts res.status===401 and res.body.error==='Unauthorized'. vitest run: 20 passed (20).

criteria.description: GET /products with Authorization: Bearer odd-token-1 (digit sum=1, odd) returns HTTP 401 and { "error": "Unauthorized" }.
criteria.evidence: Test 'returns 401 with odd-digit-sum token' passed: sends Authorization: Bearer odd-token-1, asserts res.status===401 and res.body.error==='Unauthorized'. vitest run: 20 passed (20).

criteria.description: GET /products with Authorization: Bearer benchmark-token-2024 (digit sum=8, even) returns HTTP 200.
criteria.evidence: Test 'returns 200 with valid even-digit-sum token' passed: sends Authorization: Bearer benchmark-token-2024, asserts res.status===200. vitest run: 20 passed (20).

criteria.description: GET /health with no Authorization header returns HTTP 200 and JSON body { "status": "ok" } (no auth middleware).
criteria.evidence: Test '/health does not require auth' passed: sends GET /health with no Authorization header, asserts res.status===200 and res.body.status==='ok'. vitest run: 20 passed (20).
